_comment: Maps logical field names (as used in schema_kg / schema.yaml) → physical parquet column names for UniProt. Needed because database_loader.py renames columns at load time. HAND-MAINTAINED — do not overwrite with gen_schema.py --write.
_section_protein_master_table: protein_master_table_uniprot_v2 — parquet already uses protein_id/ensembl_accession/entrez; only hgnc_id→hgnc rename survives
_section_gene_protein_association: gene_protein_xwalk_uniprot — same accession/ensembl_id/entrez_id renames plus gene_symbol renamed to avoid cross-table collision
_section_gene_ontology: gene_ontology_uniprot — gene_symbol renamed to avoid collision with protein_master_table
_section_subcell_location: subcell_location_uniprot — keyword column renamed to keyword_id for FK join; description/synonyms/hierarchy/entry_type prefixed with subcell_
